source: The original paper contrasts this approach with approximate attention methods that reduce arithmetic by changing the mathematical problem. Dense ZXNAME0000XZ does not make that trade. The same paper also introduced a block-sparse extension, but that sparse extension is a different case because omitting blocks changes which interactions are computed.[4]
zh: 原始论文将这种方法与通过改变数学问题来减少算术的近似注意方法进行了对比。 Dense ZXNAME0000XZ 不会进行该交易。同一篇论文还介绍了块稀疏扩展，但稀疏扩展是一种不同的情况，因为省略块会改变计算交互的方式。 [4]
